title: Route Nodes
description: Ordered array of route nodes for the Aconcagua Normal Route. Each node encodes terrain semantics consumed by calculateEnvironmentalPressureScore(). Order (routeIndex) defines the canonical POSITIONS array.

nodeId.description: Unique snake_case identifier. Normalized to id by normalizeRouteData().

nodeName.description: Human-readable display name shown in UI route strip and debrief.

altitudeMeters.description: Actual altitude in metres. Informational only; engine uses altitudeBand.

altitudeBand.description: Discrete altitude band (0–4) used as key in altitudePressureByBand.

terrainLoad.description: Terrain difficulty (1–5) used as key in terrainLoadScale.

weatherBias.description: Additive offset to EP from this node's weather exposure.

visibilityBias.description: Additive offset to EP from this node's visibility exposure.

timeSensitivity.description: Multiplier applied to the time-of-day risk component.

isCamp.description: True when the node is a designated camp where sleep is available.

stageHint.description: Stage assignment. Normalized to stage by normalizeRouteData().

routeIndex.description: Zero-based ordinal defining canonical POSITIONS order.
